# moodle-cli 0.7.0-alpha.6

This prerelease fixes three problems found while dogfooding a real managed Moodle MCP deployment on Cloudflare Workers.

## Fixed in alpha.6

- Report the actual cause when the browser cookie store cannot be read (a sandboxed terminal, missing Full Disk Access) instead of misreporting it as "not logged in" and looping a browser login to a timeout.
- Spawn the MCP bridge and the session renewal job through the running Node binary instead of the bare script path, so GUI MCP clients and launchd/systemd/schtasks jobs no longer fail to start when Node comes from a version manager.
- Record the release digest reliably in `moodle mcp status` and the deployment receipt. Wrangler's `deployments list --json` only carries deployment-level annotations, so a version promoted without one previously read back with an empty digest even though the receipt already had it.

## Validation

- Typechecking, the full Node test suite, and the CLI/Worker build all pass on the merged fix set.
- The renewal job and all five bridge client connectors (Codex, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor) were re-verified end to end against a live deployment under a launchd-equivalent minimal `PATH`.

The `alpha` npm dist-tag moves to this release. The stable `latest` dist-tag remains on `0.6.0`.
